UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA
ALEXANDRIA DIVISION
MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,
Plaintiff,
Case No. 1:26-cv-02331
V.
KATIE HALL, individually;
NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED
CHILDREN;
META PLATFORMS, INC.;
and JOHN/JANE DOES 1-6,
Defendants.
PROPOSEDI ORDER
This matter is before the Court on Plaintiff's Motion for Leave to File Consolidated
Statement of Procedural Irregularities and Judicial Actions. Upon consideration of the motion, the
memorandum in support, and the declaration accompanying it, it is hereby
ORDERED that the motion is GRANTED; and it is further
ORDERED that the Clerk shall docket Exhibit A to the motion, titled Plaintiff's
Consolidated Statement of Procedural Irregularities and Judicial Actions, as a separate entry on
the docket of this action.
The Clerk is directed to send a copy of this Order to Plaintiff at his address of record and
to counsel of record.
1

It is SO ORDERED.
Alexandria, Virginia
- 2026
Rossie D. Alston, Jr.
United States District Judge
2
